What kind of site is it?: A consumer language-learning app. Anyone can use it, most people are on it casually rather than for work.
What's your biggest concern right now?: The homepage has to persuade a stranger in a few seconds, and I don't know whether it does. Our visitors aren't buying a tool for a team, they're deciding whether to bother.
Where do they seem to drop off?: Before they ever start — they land, look, and go.
Anything else we should know?: A lot of our traffic is on phones, but audit the desktop page for now.
